notes.title: Bug fixes, fire nerf, 1 hour limit
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed damage text display issues beyond 3 numbers, should now display up to 5 numbers or 4 numbers + "K" or "M" for thousand or million
[*]Nerfed fire damage ticks 0.15s>0.25s
[*]When timer hits 1 hour, now spawns a very fast and very strong boss intended to end the game.
[*]Fixed purification zone damage cooldown increasing instead of decreasing
[/list]

notes.title: First weapon upgrade released!
notes.notes:
First weapon upgrade is complete! This upgrade is for the spiral weapon. Level up weapon damage to 10 and it will upgrade automatically! A new icon in the scroll shop will tell you that your weapon is upgraded!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983041/a0fedecaac29bc0d2bb57a3b83f310e03e454ef3.gif[/img]

For this upgrade, projectiles will automatically home in to nearby targets!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983041/f24edc5766eca3abf183e964f952384747874a7f.gif[/img]
